SELECT m.id AS id, m.bus_no AS itemCode, m.name AS itemName, COALESCE(category_concept.display, m.category_code) AS categoryName, m.total_volume AS specification, COALESCE(inventory.stock_quantity, 0) AS stockQuantity, m.stock_unit_code AS stockUnitCode, COALESCE(unit_concept.display, m.stock_unit_code) AS stockUnitName, ( SELECT price.price_value FROM adm_charge_item_definition price WHERE price.instance_table = 'med_medication_definition' AND price.instance_id = m.id AND price.price_type_code = 'SALE' AND price.is_deleted = 0 AND price.status_enum = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY COALESCE(price.priority, 2147483647), price.id LIMIT 1 ) AS unitPrice FROM med_medication_definition m
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT item_id, unit_code, SUM(quantity) AS stock_quantity FROM wkf_inventory_item WHERE item_table = 'med_medication_definition' AND is_deleted = 0 AND inventory_status_enum = 'ACTIVE' AND location_id = #{locationId} GROUP BY item_id, unit_code ) inventory ON inventory.item_id = m.id AND inventory.unit_code = m.stock_unit_code
LEFT JOIN ter_concept category_concept ON category_concept.code_system_id = '900006' AND category_concept.code = m.category_code AND category_concept.is_active = 1 AND category_concept.is_deleted = 0
LEFT JOIN ter_concept unit_concept ON unit_concept.code_system_id = '279125561775755265' AND unit_concept.code = m.stock_unit_code AND unit_concept.is_active = 1 AND unit_concept.is_deleted = 0
m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.active_flag = 1 AND m.status_enum = 'ACTIVE'
AND ( m.bus_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR m.merchandise_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR m.py_str LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR m.wb_str LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
AND m.category_code = #{query.categoryCode}
ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC
